Module Architecture

Spring is structured as a set of modules layered on top of the Core Container. Pick only what you need — each module is independently deployable as a Maven/Gradle dependency. Version Timeline

Spring 5.x targets Java 8+ with javax.* namespaces (Jakarta EE 8). Spring 6.x requires Java 17+ and migrates to jakarta.* namespaces (Jakarta EE 9+). Spring 5.3.x is the LTS release receiving maintenance until 2024; Spring 6.x is the active development line. 5.0 Sep 2017 5.1 Sep 2018 5.2 Sep 2019 5.

XML vs Annotation Configuration[Basic]

Spring supports three configuration styles that can be freely mixed: legacy XML ( <bean> elements), annotation-driven classpath scanning ( @Component + @ComponentScan ), and Java-based configuration ( @Configuration + @Bean ). @Configuration, @Bean, @Conditional & @Profile[Intermediate]
